column1: # Persian words that begin with ال, so ال in them is not the Arabic article.
# Every ال-word seen in at least three clearly Persian lines (two or more Persian
# function words, no Arabic cue) of a 5% development partition, 8,610 documents,
# of a 2026 corpus of Ganjoor, Wikisource and Wikipedia. Evidence of Persian use,
# not proof that a word is never Arabic. 306 words.
